project_address: 2860 N Old Lake Wilson Rd, Kissimmee, FL 34747

sections.title: A. Service & Distribution

bullets.t: the complete service entrance: utility metering provisions, meter base (NEMA 3R), and service gutter/wireway (NEMA 3R), fed by parallel (2) sets of 4#3/0 & #6 ground in 2" conduit from the meter to the wireway.

two (2) 225A MLO panelboards — Panel A and Panel B (208Y/120V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 42-circuit), furnished by AutoZone and installed by the Electrical Contractor. EC to receive, set, and connect with feeders and grounding throughout.
two (2) 200A NEMA 3R fused disconnects and the 60A non-fused RTU disconnects, furnished and installed by APT.

bullets: Provide all feeders, branch raceways, and conductors per the one-line and panel schedules.

sections.title: B. Branch Power

bullets.t: branch power and final connections for all equipment, including two (2) 10-ton rooftop units (60A/3P), water heater, five (5) battery chargers, and miscellaneous equipment per the panel schedules.

bullets: Provide all receptacles, retail power poles, and display baseflex floor connections per the power plans.

sections.title: C. Lighting & Controls
bullets: Lighting fixtures furnished by the Owner through the Graybar national account. EC to receive, inventory, and install all fixtures per schedule.

bullets.t: Venstar lighting control panel / contactor enclosure, roof-mounted photocell, occupancy/motion sensors, and data concentrator (Owner-furnished, EC-installed and wired); functional testing prior to final inspection.

sections.title: D. Site Lighting, Underground Work & Allowances
bullets: Install four (4) AutoZone-furnished pole-top area lights on three (3) site poles. Site pole light bases (3 total) to be formed and poured by others; EC to set anchor bolts and conduit stub-ups as required.
120' allowance - 2" network conduit from the building.
120' allowance - conduit from the utility transformer to the traffic box per civil plans (no wiring shown).
25' allowance - secondary feeders from the utility transformer.

sections.title: E. Low Voltage Infrastructure (Conduit & Boxes Only)
bullets: Provide empty conduit and pull strings only for data/communications and fire alarm systems. No fire alarm devices, wiring, or programming and no data cabling, devices, or programming are included — conduit and pull strings only.

sections.title: F. Project Coordination & Closeout
bullets: Coordinate with Summit General Contractors and other trades for scheduling, tie-ins, and access; provide testing, inspections, and closeout documentation prior to final inspection.

exclusions: Panelboards and the complete lighting package are furnished by AutoZone; EC to receive, handle, and install. Disconnects are furnished and installed by APT.
Site pole light bases (3 total) to be formed and poured by others.
Fire alarm: conduit and pull strings only — no devices, wiring, or programming.
Data / communications: conduit and pull strings only — no cabling, devices, or programming (by Owner's vendor).

Underground allowances per civil: 120 LF primary conduit, 25 LF secondary feeders, 120 LF transformer-to-traffic-box conduit (no wiring shown), and 120 LF 2" network conduit from the building. Footage in excess of these allowances will be billed by Change Order.
Utility company transformer, primary-side work, and utility fees are excluded.
Painting, patching, concrete cutting, core drilling, and finish restoration are excluded.
Trenching, backfill, and final grading by others unless noted.

items.description: Fire alarm conduit & pull strings (no devices)
